Fixed on fix/pylint-ci branch (commit bdfadcc). Investigated all four candidate categories by sampling actual findings rather than assuming: (1) broad-exception-caught (58) confirmed intentional -- disabled repo-wide via [tool.pylint.messages_control] in pyproject.toml with rationale comment. (2) redefined-outer-name (190) + unused-argument (354) confirmed ~97% pytest-fixture idiom in tests/ but with real hits mixed into src/ (e.g. daz_browse_category's unwired sort_by param) -- scoped both disables to tests/ only in pylint.yml so src/ findings stay visible for r13's audit. (3) no-name-in-module/no-member (225) confirmed NOT false positives -- real stale imports from pre-refactor server.py module path, same root cause as zp7; left enabled, notes added to ful for the follow-up fix. (4) missing-*-docstring (491) left enabled per the issue's own framing as a real decision, not a false positive -- tracked by dk7. Verified locally: src/ alone now scores 7.34/10 in isolation with the split config.

Already resolved by daz-mcp-server-0t0's config change (commit bdfadcc on fix/pylint-ci): confirmed all 190 hits were the pytest-fixture-as-parameter idiom (100% in tests/, 0 in src/), and pylint.yml already scopes --disable=redefined-outer-name to tests/. Verified: 'pylint --disable=all --enable=redefined-outer-name' on src/ scores 10.00/10 (zero hits), and the actual CI-configured tests/ command produces zero redefined-outer-name findings.

Fixed on fix/pylint-ci branch (commit f781e41). Audited all ~10 src/ + integration_test.py unused-argument findings individually (tests/ 344 hits already handled by 0t0's scoped pylint.yml disable). 7 confirmed genuine false positives (FastMCP lifespan signature, three already-documented 'reserved for future' / 'not yet implemented' tool params, and two test-suite functions kept for a uniform callback signature) -- added inline '# pylint: disable=unused-argument' with a one-line reason at each. 3 were real defects masquerading as unused params (daz_get_scene_layout/daz_find_nearby_nodes's include_types filter and daz_batch_select's add_to_selection never actually implemented despite being documented) -- filed as daz-mcp-server-skr and daz-mcp-server-i2l instead of silencing them, left the pylint warning live since it's correctly flagging incomplete code. Verified locally: src/ isolated unused-argument count drops from ~10 to exactly the 3 filed bugs.

Fixed on fix/pylint-ci branch (commit 696b859). 491 findings (387 function + 99 class + 5 module) broke down as: 12 in src/, 12 in integration_test.py, and 467 (95%) in tests/. All @mcp.tool() functions already had full docstrings -- the LLM-facing API surface this check protects was already covered. Wrote real one-line docstrings for the 24 src/+integration_test.py hits (singleton accessors, main(), 5 tool submodule docstrings, and each test_* suite function). For tests/'s 467 hits -- confirmed self-descriptively-named test_* functions and TestXxx grouping classes -- extended pylint.yml's existing tests/-scoped disable list (from 0t0/91s) with missing-function-docstring/missing-class-docstring; module docstrings remain required everywhere including tests/. Verified locally: src/ isolated docstring score 10.00/10 (zero hits); the CI-configured tests/ command produces zero missing-*-docstring findings.

Fixed on fix/pylint-ci branch (commit 1eb4009). Confirmed the pre-investigation from 0t0: 221 of 225 findings were the same stale-import root cause as zp7 (17 test files + integration_test.py still importing from the flat pre-refactor vangard_daz_mcp.server module). Repointed every import at its real owning submodule and replaced server_module._http_client-style attribute assignment with _client.py's actual set_http_client() API. 1 finding (scene.py:295) is a genuine pylint inference gap -- identical ._identifier.value access works uncomplained-about in 4 other spots -- fixed with a targeted inline disable and rationale. The remaining 4 (DazBusyError/StudioBusyError/ConcurrencyLimitError) are real but blocked on an unpublished dazpy 2.8.0 release -- filed as daz-mcp-server-9av rather than silenced. Verification also surfaced an unrelated pre-existing bug (6 test_server.py tests silently hitting a live DAZ Studio instead of being mocked, same gap 4712f41 already fixed on phase4_tools_implementation but never ported here) -- filed as daz-mcp-server-rxu rather than fixed inline since it's a distinct mocking-architecture issue. Verified locally: no-member/no-name-in-module drops from 225 to the 4 tracked in 9av; pytest --collect-only collects 441 tests with zero import errors.

Fixed on fix/pylint-ci branch (commit 5d0212c). Reviewed all 5 protected-access findings individually -- all the same shape: reading a node's internal name via ._identifier.value on a DazNode-family object (scene.py's daz_list_children/daz_get_parent/daz_get_selected_nodes, camera_light.py's daz_list_lights/daz_list_cameras). Confirmed against daz-script-server's own README that this is dazpy's documented, intended way to read a node's name, not a code smell -- added a targeted inline disable at each site (kept narrow, not a blanket file/project-wide disable, since protected-access elsewhere would still be worth a real look). Verified locally: protected-access is 10.00/10 repo-wide; pytest --collect-only collects 441 tests.

Fixed on fix/pylint-ci branch (commit 6e1b1b2). Reviewed all 16 duplicate-code findings individually per the issue's own suggested approach. Two were genuine substantial duplication, extracted into shared code: _EMOTION_DEFINITIONS (~100-line dict, byte-identical in tools/morph.py and tools/cinematic.py) moved to new src/vangard_daz_mcp/_emotions.py; and _mcp.py's _execute()/tools/utility.py's daz_execute()/daz_execute_file() shared payload+error-handling logic consolidated into two new _mcp.py helpers (_execute_payload, _execute_raw) while preserving each function's distinct return shape. The remaining 12 pairs matched the issue's own hypothesis -- the try/except run_dazpy() wrapper repeated by architecture across nearly every dazpy-routed tool -- confirmed by testing that raising pylint's min-similarity-lines from 4 to 8 collapses 11 of them to zero; added that threshold to pyproject.toml's [tool.pylint.similarities] with rationale. The one survivor (conftest.py vs test_phase5_integration.py fixtures, ~50 lines) is a pre-existing SKILL_DEVELOPMENT.md-documented deliberate choice -- added a targeted inline disable instead of raising the threshold further. Verified locally: duplicate-code is 10.00/10; unused-import/no-member/no-name-in-module/protected-access remain 10.00/10 (no regressions); pytest --collect-only collects 441 tests; test_server.py + test_wardrobe.py (89 tests) pass.
